title: Johnny Bayersdorffer at the Tokyo Gardens
summary: He admired Bayersdorffer's band with Pete Scaglione and Tom Brown, but lost faith when Johnny returned from Chicago with a weakened lip.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

I can't understand how he felt like he did, Johnny Posdorff. Mm-hmm. Oh, when Johnny was at the Tokyo Garden with Pete Skaglione and them guys, they had a group out of this world. They already played with him out there. Mm-hmm. They had a group out of this world, eh, for dance music. They really played some nice stuff. And then... Tom played nice trombone with them, too.
